name: Cutaway
biography: Jack of All Trades and hardware attack dog for the InGuardians founders. I specialize in physical and information technology penetration testing, web assessments, wireless assessments, architecture review, incident response/digital forensics, product research, hardware research, code review, security tool development, and the list goes on. I am currently focusing on hardware research specifically in the technologies surrounding products comprising the SMART GRID with a focus on implementing Zigbee protocol API's and microprocessor disassembers/emulators for research, testing, risk assessment, and anything else you can think of with these technologies.
